resources.string: IdeaForge sends your idea and answers to %1$s to generate questions and your write-up. %1$s’s terms govern what it keeps.

IdeaForge sends your idea and answers to %1$s at %2$s to generate questions and your write-up. That server’s operator controls what it keeps. Optional hosted transcription and speech use separate services and choices.
Enter a valid local server address before agreeing to send interview text.
Interview text sent over HTTP is not encrypted in transit. Prefer HTTPS with a certificate trusted by this device.
I agree to send interview text to %1$s.
This agreement is separate from connection checks, microphone permission and hosted voice choices. Uncheck to withdraw; save a new agreement with this connection.
Interview text will not be sent until you review and agree to the chosen provider in Settings. Your local ideas and exports are still here.
